text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Um! Can we add some more weight to
the
barbell? I think I can do more!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Roger dodger!
choice_data_list: じゃあ、明日はプレートを足そうか
choice_data_list_en: Then let's add some more plates tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is making great progress
with her
training as her debut draws
closer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every Tracen student enters the
academy with an
already high level of
innate skill, and Yukino Bijin
is no
exception—she is incredibly talented.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: D'you really think so? Ehehe...
choice_data_list: パワーは申し分ないな
パワーは申し分ないね
choice_data_list_en: Your power is certainly not in doubt.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I used t'help with farm work and shovel'n
snow
back home. Guess that toughened
me up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm gonna go change! Can't be
stroll'n into
a cafe dressed like this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Did someone say "cafe"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparkle! Dazzle!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-oh my stars! City! H-h-h-hi there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I swear, I will never get tired of that reaction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City is a racer known for her
beauty, even
working as a model. Her
strength as a racer is
undeniable,
though. She's done well in many G1s,

and even won some.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you be used to seeing me by
now?
We're schoolmates.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidd'n?! How could I ever get
used
t'seeing someone straight outta the
magazines I
read?! That's bonkers!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cool racers like you are what made me
wanna
move out here in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It still feels like a dream talk'n t'you like
this,
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Plus, y'can't really blame me for being a li'l starstruck when y'come at me outta nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay, but you gotta admit, it is low-key funny that it happens every time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you were saying something
about going
to a cafe? Where at?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's called Cafe Seattle! We're going
shopp'n, but
I wanna stop at the cafe
first.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
For real? I'm just getting ready to go
there too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then, um... d'ya wanna go with us?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Now that was scrum-diddly-umptious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how much fruit they
packed into
m'cup! Even iced tea is
fancy in the city, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the iced tea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to pay for me
too...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Yukino... How have things
been with
you lately?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Lately? Well, I feel like my days're
mostly just
packed to the brim with
train'n!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah, that's... true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City looks like she wants to say
something,
but Yukino Bijin doesn't
seem to be picking up on
that at all. I
decide to ease things along.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 君から見て、最近のユキノはどう？
貴方から見て、最近のユキノはどう？
choice_data_list_en: From your perspective, how's Yukino been lately?
How has Yukino been doing lately from your point of view?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-where'd that come from?! B-but I
mean... I'd
love t'know what y'think...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You've been the talk of the town lately.
I heard
you even have a fan club.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. It's really someth'n, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Getting attention isn't bad in and of
itself, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Is that Gold City? No wonder she's
known mostly
for her beauty! She's
gorgeous!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, just don't put too much stock
in others'
opinions about you. Keep
doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'd be happy to lend an ear if you ever
need to
talk, so feel free to come to me
whenever.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're so kind, City...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But it's okay, 'cause I'm gonna be just
peachy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I have faith people will start cheer'n me
on for
real as long as I keep plugg'n
away!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'm... sure you'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A flicker of unease seems to pass across
Gold
City's face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I, uh... I'm gonna go wash my hands real
quick!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Uh, okay...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nah... It's not anything you have to
thank me for.
choice_data_list: ユキノを気遣ってくれてありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for looking out for Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just wonder if that's really how she
feels...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She said she'll be just fine, but will she?
Is she?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So many people are already talking
about her.
And not just about her
running, but her
appearance too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: There's no way all this talk isn't affecting her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For better or for worse, her work as a
model
brought her a lot of attention
after her debut,
and her name was on
everyone's lips.
choice_data_list: （そういえば……ゴールドシチーも）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's likely why she's so worried about
Yukino
Bijin. She's been in the same
position before.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Besides... No matter how much faith she
has in
herself...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just keep a close eye on her, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I've got to head off. Good luck
with your
debut.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. City looks so cool and collected even while walk'n off all casual-like...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have struggled with what to say
to me,
but Gold City is the picture of a
dependable
mentor when she's in front
of Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll ever be able t'become a
glam'rous
city girl like her...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're right!
